---
name: 撤下请求 / Takedown request
about: Ask us to remove work shown on the site
title: "[撤下] "
labels: takedown
---

We take the content down first and verify afterwards. See https://variantdesign.xyz/submit.

- 本站页面链接 / Page on this site:
- 作品原始链接 / Original work:
- 你的身份或与作品的关系 / Who you are, or your relation to the work:
- 说明 / Details:
- 希望撤下的媒体（如有）/ Media to remove (if applicable):

For authorized submissions, removal replaces the current record with an unindexed notice and stops media loading. Old Git history, files already downloaded and third-party caches cannot be recalled from this site.
授权投稿撤下后，当前登记只保留不被索引的撤下说明，停止加载媒体；本站无法收回旧 Git 历史、已下载文件或第三方缓存。
